title: VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight review: 10,000 runners through the night of 29-30 November 2025 in cold weather, from Thien Quang Lake through central Hanoi.
dek: Hanoi's night marathon drew 10,000 runners through the cold night of 29 to 30 November 2025, its fifth edition. Here is what it was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight is a night race through central Hanoi. The fifth edition, run through the night of 29 to 30 November 2025, drew 10,000 runners despite the cold [1]. The atmosphere stretched from Thien Quang Lake through the central streets [1]. Kenya's Ezekiel Kipruto Kemboi won the men's marathon in 2:24:20, and Pham Thi Hong Le won the women's in about 2:56, her 17th win in the VnExpress series, while leading a pack of sub-three-hour runners [1]. If you want a marathon under Hanoi's streetlights, this is the one.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The race ran through the night of 29 November and the early morning of 30 November 2025, and drew 10,000 runners, despite cold weather in the capital [1]. It was the race's fifth season [1].
The race area ran from Thien Quang Lake through the central streets of Hanoi, which the report described as lively all night [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Ezekiel Kipruto Kemboi and Takele Kure of Kenya ran together to about 18 km before Kemboi pulled away, leading by two minutes by 33 km and winning in 2:24:20 [1]. Trinh Minh Tam, in a first year of running marathons, was third in a personal best of 2:27 [1].

Pham Thi Hong Le set the pace for a group of runners aiming for under three hours, with dozens of men running in her pack, and won in about 2:56, 44 seconds ahead of Vu Khanh Linh [1]. Samuel Kalalei of Kenya led the men's half marathon from start to finish in 1:08:55 [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a night marathon through the centre of Hanoi with a big field and a competitive front end.
Dress for the weather. Late November nights in Hanoi can be cold, as they were in 2025, so plan layers for the start and after the finish.
This review is compiled from a published race report on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight in 2025?
faqs.answer: 10,000 runners took part through the night of 29 to 30 November 2025, the race's fifth edition, despite cold weather in Hanoi. The race area ran from Thien Quang Lake through the city's central streets.

faqs.question: Who won VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight 2025?
faqs.answer: Kenya's Ezekiel Kipruto Kemboi won the men's marathon in 2:24:20, two minutes ahead of Takele Kure. Pham Thi Hong Le won the women's in about 2:56, her 17th VnExpress series win. Samuel Kalalei won the men's half marathon in 1:08:55.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at Hanoi Midnight?
faqs.answer: Cold, by Southeast Asian standards. The 2025 race was run through a chilly late-November night, so bring layers for the start and a warm top for after the finish.
